title: Agrifood LCA (proposal) - AgriCropCycle
description: One crop grown on one AgriParcel in one season: the unit of record in a contract-growing system (ViRe-like) and the functional unit for farm-stage LCA. Complements SDM AgriParcel/AgriCrop, which describe the land and the crop but not a seasonal production record with inputs and yield.

hasAgriParcel.description: Relationship. The AgriParcel the crop was grown on.

precedingCrop.description: Relationship. AgriCrop grown on the parcel the previous season (rotation).

hasGrowingSeasonWeather.description: Relationship. Season weather summary applicable to the parcel.

nitrogenMineralApplied.description: Property. Mineral fertiliser nitrogen. Units:'kg N/ha'.

manureNitrogenApplied.description: Property. Total N in manure. Units:'kg N/ha'.

pesticideActiveIngredientApplied.description: Property. Plant protection products, active ingredient. Units:'kg a.i./ha'.

dieselConsumption.description: Property. Diesel for field operations. Units:'l/ha'.

harvestedYield.description: Property. Marketable raw yield; observedAt = harvest date. Units:'t/ha'.

harvestBatchId.description: Property. Batch identifier for field-to-product traceability.

missingAttributes.description: Property. Attributes the grower did not report (provenance; kept after gap filling). Remaining gaps = missingAttributes minus imputedAttributes.

dataOrigin.description: Property. Sub-property on every input/output attribute. Origin of the value.

imputationMethod.description: Property. Sub-property, only when dataOrigin=imputed. E.g. 'gradientBoosting', 'knn', 'cropRegionMedian'.

imputationModel.description: Property. Sub-property. Identifier/version of the model that produced the value.

confidenceInterval.description: Property. Sub-property. {'lower': n, 'upper': n, 'level': 0.8} for imputed/estimated values.

contractCrop.description: Property. Grown under the contractor's (Apetit) contract and recorded in its system; rotation crops are usually not.

imputedAttributes.description: Property. Attributes added by gap filling (each carries dataOrigin=imputed, imputationMethod, imputationModel, confidenceInterval). missingAttributes is kept as provenance.
